checkedOccurrences.textualBasisJa: Joshua the son of Nun secretly sent two men out of Shittim as spies, saying, “Go, view the land, including Jericho.” They went and came into the house of a prostitute whose name was Rahab, and slept there.
Joshua got up early in the morning; and they moved from Shittim and came to the Jordan, he and all the children of Israel. They camped there before they crossed over.

wikipediaActualRead.title: Shittim
wikipediaActualRead.identityBasisJa: 記事は曖昧さ回避ページで、聖書の場所としてAbel-Shittim/Ha-Shittimを示し、別の現代のShitim集落とも分ける。これだけではヨシュア記の宿営地の正確な位置を確定しない。

geographyAssessmentJa: 宿営地候補として既存候補は保持可能だが、候補位置は現代集落との同一性未確認。都市ピンでなく「伝承候補地」と表示する。
